idea.title: The earl behind the sandwich
idea.summary: Sandwich is named after John Montagu, 4th Earl of Sandwich; the card-game legend is uncertain. Closes on asking a stranger their favourite sandwich and telling them whose name it is.
hookOptions: Your lunch is named after a real earl
A sandwich is named after a real man
Nobody agrees why sandwiches have that name
I said sandwich all my life, never knew why
sources: Wikipedia: Sandwich: named after John Montagu, 4th Earl of Sandwich (1718-1792); the card-game story is the popular tale, others say he ate at his desk, so it is uncertain.
Wikipedia: John Montagu, 4th Earl of Sandwich: title from the town of Sandwich in Kent.

scenes.say: Your lunch is named after a real English earl. Nobody agrees why.

scenes.caption: The Earl, 1718-1792
scenes.say: John Montagu was the fourth Earl of Sandwich, a title from a town in Kent.
Legend says he wanted food to eat while playing cards.
Or he ate at his desk. Nobody knows.

scenes.name: Crunchy Pickle
scenes.say: Ask a stranger their favourite sandwich. Then tell them it's an earl's name.

scenes.ask: What's the best sandwich you've had?

post.caption:
Sandwich was a man's title before it was lunch. Nobody agrees on why he got the credit. What's the best sandwich you've ever had? Ask a stranger theirs on randomtalker.com.

Photos via Wikimedia Commons: Johann Zoffany (Public domain)
